blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce Almieyar , a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding ≈ \approx 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0 % 35.0\% , followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1 % 41.1\% , 45.9 % 45.9\% , and 49.5 % 49.5\% , respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. Almieyar provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.
blocks.zh: 阿拉伯语的语音技术主要集中于现代标准阿拉伯语,使得数亿人的活方言服务不足. 我们提出Almiayar, 这是一个基于文化的ASR基准, 覆盖6个家庭的17个阿拉伯语方言, 对话社区协调员在10个专题中选择了与文化相关的图像,当地人通过5个结构化的情景加以描述,每个方言大约为50分钟(共13.7小时)。 我们以12种最先进的ASR系统为基准,包括GPT-4o-trancis,Voxtral-Mini-4B,Fanar-STT-LF,Whisper,SeamlessM4T-v2,以及wav2vec2基模型. GPT-4o-trancis的WER总成绩最低,为35.0% 35.0========================================================================================================================================================================================================================================= 不同方言组的表现差异很大,没有一种模式在所有组别中表现得一致。 单是WER还模糊了方言ASR行为:wav2vec2-基于WER/CER的模型显示出很大的WER/CER差距,其中字符级协议仍然比单词级精确度高得多,激发了WER/CER联合报告. Almieyar为基于文化的阿拉伯ASR评价提供了统一基准,包括首次公布的Ahwazi阿拉伯语基准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Arabic is spoken by over 420 million people across 22 countries [ 7 ] , yet its linguistic landscape is far from homogeneous. The gap between Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), used in formal writing and broadcast media, and the diverse spoken dialects is vast, with many varieties mutually unintelligible [ 21 ] . Critically, MSA is not a mother tongue . The Arabic that people actually live in , the Arabic of family gatherings, cultural celebrations, and daily life, is dialectal. Yet ASR research has been overwhelmingly dominated by MSA and a small number of high-resource dialects such as Egyptian [ 11 , 1 ] , leaving many spoken Arabic varieties under-represented in current speech technologies.
This gap affects the accessibility of voice technologies for speakers of dialects such as Moroccan Darija, Sudanese Arabic, and Ahwazi Arabic (the latter with essentially no prior ASR research). Existing multi-dialect benchmarks, including MGB-2 [ 4 ] , NADI 2025 [ 19 ] , and Casablanca [ 18 ] , remain limited both in dialectal coverage, where no prior benchmark distinguishes more than eight varieties (Table 1 ), and in data provenance, since their speech is sourced from broadcast or social media that models may have seen during training. We address both limitations with Almieyar , a benchmark designed for contamination-free evaluation of Arabic dialect ASR across diverse dialect communities.
blocks.zh:
22个国家的4.2亿人讲阿拉伯语,但其语言面貌远非单一。 在正式写作和广播媒体中使用的现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA)与多种口语方言之间的差距很大,许多品种相互无法理解[21]. 关键的是,生活津贴不是母语。 人们实际生活的阿拉伯语, 家庭聚会、文化庆典和日常生活的阿拉伯语, 是方言。 然而ASR的研究却以MSA和少量高资源方言如埃及语[11,1]为主,使得许多阿拉伯语品种在目前语音技术中代表不足.
这一差距影响到诸如摩洛哥语Darija、苏丹阿拉伯语和Ahwazi阿拉伯语(后者基本上没有ASR研究)等方言使用者获得语音技术。 现有的多语言基准,包括MGB-2[4]、NADI 2025[19]和卡萨布兰卡[18],在方言覆盖方面仍然有限,因为以前的基准没有区分超过8个品种(表1),在数据来源方面,因为其言论来源于广播或社交媒体,这些模式在培训期间可能见过。 我们用Almiayar来解决这两个限制,

blocks.en: Contributions. • Broad dialect coverage. 17 dialects across six families, including the first published ASR benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic, spoken by ≈ 3 {\approx}3 – 5 5 million people in Khuzestan, Iran. • Contamination-free speech. All recordings are new, elicited specifically for this work; none has appeared in any prior corpus, reducing the risk of evaluation leakage. • Cultural grounding. Each utterance describes a community-curated image across 10 thematic topics, eliciting vocabulary and contexts that broadcast-derived corpora may systematically miss. • Multi-system evaluation. 12 ASR systems, including open-weight and closed-weight models, are evaluated zero-shot under WER, CER, and MER to analyse model behaviour across diverse Arabic dialects.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 • 方言覆盖面广。 伊朗Khuzestan有5百万人使用17种方言, • 无污染言论。 所有录音都是新录音,是专门为这项工作而录制的;没有任何录音出现在任何前科中,从而减少了评估泄漏的风险。 • 文化基础。 每句话都描述了一个社区确定10个主题的图像,引出广播衍生的公司可能系统错过的词汇和背景。 • 多系统评价。 12 ASR系统,包括开放重量模型和封闭重量模型,在WER、CER和MER下评价零镜头,以分析不同阿拉伯语方言的模型行为。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large-scale models such as Whisper [ 15 ] and Conformer-based systems [ 16 , 11 ] have pushed Arabic ASR WER below 10%, but primarily on MSA-focused evaluation settings. Standard benchmarks reinforce this imbalance: MGB-2 is drawn from Aljazeera broadcast media and is dialectally mixed but predominantly MSA, while MGB-3 and MGB-5 target Egyptian and Moroccan respectively [ 4 , 6 , 5 ] ; Common Voice and FLEURS provide Arabic speech resources but have limited representation of Arabic dialect diversity [ 8 , 10 ] ; SADA covers four dialects [ 3 ] ; NADI 2025 reaches eight [ 19 ] ; Casablanca covers eight [ 18 ] . Entire families, including Ahwazi, much of the Gulf, and several Maghrebi varieties, remain absent. Most prior corpora are also drawn from broadcast or YouTube sources, which may overlap with large-scale training data. Where genuinely unseen dialectal speech is evaluated, performance can degrade substantially: [ 13 ] report 78.8 % 78.8\% zero-shot WER on Sudanese Arabic. Culturally grounded benchmarking has gained traction in NLP [ 20 , 2 ] but has not been widely applied to Arabic ASR; Almieyar fills this gap. Table 1 positions it against prior Arabic ASR benchmarks: it combines broad dialectal coverage with newly generated, culturally grounded speech designed for contamination-free evaluation.
blocks.zh: 诸如Whisper [15]和Conformer系统[16,11]等大规模模型将阿拉伯ASR WER推向了10%以下,但主要针对以MSA为重点的评价设置. 标准基准强化了这种不平衡:MGB-2来自Aljazeera广播媒体,方言混合,但以MSA为主,而MGB-3和MGB-5分别针对埃及语和摩洛哥语[4,6,5];共同之声和FLEURS提供阿拉伯语语音资源,但阿拉伯语方言多样性的代表性有限[8,10];SADA涵盖四种方言[3];NADI 2025达到8 [19];卡萨布兰卡涵盖8 [18]. 整个家庭,包括阿瓦齐、海湾大部分地区和几个马格里布品种,仍然缺席。 大多数之前的corpora也是从广播或YouTube来源抽取的,可能与大规模培训数据重叠. 在真正隐蔽的方言言论被评价的情况下,性能会大幅下降: [13] 报告78.8%的WER在苏丹阿拉伯语上零镜头. 基于文化的基准在NLP[20,2]中得到了推动,但没有被广泛应用于阿拉伯语ASR;Almieyar填补了这一空白. 表1对照先前的阿拉伯语ASR基准将其定位为:它将广泛的方言覆盖与新产生的、基于文化的、旨在无污染评估的演讲结合起来。

blocks.en: 3 The Almieyar Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3. 阿尔米亚尔基准

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Almieyar benchmark construction pipeline. Dialect speakers describe culturally selected images across five structured scenarios using a Telegram-based collection interface. Automatic transcription is used only to assist speaker correction; final references are verified through speaker correction and coordinator review.
blocks.zh: 图1:Almiayar基准建设管道。 对话者使用基于Telegram的收集接口,描述五种结构化情景中文化上选定的图像。 自动转录仅用于协助发言者更正;最后参考资料通过发言者更正和协调者审查加以核实。

blocks.en: Table 2: Family-level WER (%) and CER (%) per model on Almieyar . Cells are colour-coded green (low) to red (high). Best per column in bold . Gulf : Bahraini, Omani, Qatari, Saudi, Yemeni; Lev. : Levantine (Jordanian, Lebanese, Palestinian, Syrian); Mag. : Maghrebi (Algerian, Libyan, Moroccan, Tunisian); Iraqi : Iraqi & Ahwazi; Egy. : Egyptian; Sud. : Sudanese; Ovr. : Overall average.
blocks.zh: 表2:Almiayar上每个模型的家庭级WER(%)和CER(%)。 单元格为颜色编码的绿色(低)至红色(高). 每栏最好用粗体表示。 海湾:巴林、阿曼、卡塔尔、沙特阿拉伯、也门;列夫:莱万丁(约旦、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦、叙利亚);马吉:马格里布(阿尔及利亚、利比亚、摩洛哥、突尼斯);伊拉克:伊拉克和阿瓦齐; Egy.:埃及语;Sud.:苏丹语;Ovr.: 总体平均数。

blocks.en: Table 3 : MER (%) per model and dialect family on Almieyar . Cells are colour-coded green (low) to red (high). Best per column in bold . Family abbreviations match Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 表3:阿尔米亚尔岛每个模型和方言家族的市面汇率(%)。 单元格为颜色编码的绿色(低)至红色(高). 每栏最好用粗体表示。 家庭缩写与表2相符.

blocks.en: Dialect coverage. The 17 target dialects across six families are represented by dialect-community coordinators : native speakers with linguistic awareness who contributed cultural expertise and joined the project as co-authors. Most speakers were young adults (approximately 20–30 years), with gender distributions varying across communities due to contributor availability.
blocks.zh: 拨号报道. 6个家庭的17种目标方言由方言-社区协调员代表:语言意识强的土著语言人贡献了文化专长,并作为共同作者参加了该项目。 大多数发言者是青年(约20-30岁),由于有捐款者,各社区的性别分布各不相同。

blocks.en: Cultural image selection. Coordinators selected culturally representative images across 10 topics : food, clothing, religious practices, historical architecture, festivals, crafts, nature, family gatherings, markets, and sports. Images were selected to reflect authentic community contexts.
blocks.zh: 文化形象选编. 协调员在10个专题中选择具有文化代表性的形象:食物、衣服、宗教习俗、历史建筑、节日、手工艺、自然、家庭聚会、市场和体育。 选择图像是为了反映真实的社区背景。

blocks.en: Five-scenario elicitation and pipeline. Speakers described each image for ≈ \approx 30–60 s using five structured scenarios covering cultural context, subjects, background, colours/mood, and interpretation. The collection yielded ≈ \approx 50 minutes per dialect and 13.7 hours overall. A Telegram-based pipeline (Figure 1 ) uses automatic transcription only for speaker correction, followed by coordinator review to verify dialect authenticity and flag code-switching.
blocks.zh: 5场的诱导和管道。 演讲者用五种结构化的情景描述每一幅图片, 收集的每个方言大约50分钟,总共13.7小时。 一个基于Telegram的管道(图1)只使用自动转录来进行扬声器校正,然后由协调员进行审查,以验证方言的真实性和国旗代码切换.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Framework
blocks.zh: 4. 评价框架

blocks.en: Models. We benchmark 12 ASR systems zero-shot: GPT-4o-transcribe , Voxtral-Mini-4B [ 14 ] , Fanar-STT-LF , Whisper-Large-v3 , Whisper-Medium , Whisper-Small [ 15 ] , SeamlessM4T-v2 [ 17 ] , Moonshine-AR [ 12 ] , Wav2Vec2-53-AR , Wav2Vec2-XLSR-AR , Wav2Vec2-XLSR-v2 [ 9 ] , and Sinai-STT 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/bakrianoo/sinai-voice-ar-stt . Since all data are newly collected, results measure out-of-domain generalisation. Models were evaluated using standard inference settings: Whisper in Arabic transcription mode, wav2vec2 systems with greedy CTC decoding, and other systems with default generation procedures.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们以12ASR系统为基准:GPT-4o-trancis,Voxtral-Mini-4B [14],Fanar-STT-LF,Whisper-Large-v3,Whisper-Medium,Whisper-Smission [15],Seamless M4T-v2 [17],Moonshine-AR [12],Wav2Vec2-XLSR-AR,Wav2Vec2-XLSR-v2 [9],和西奈-STT 1 1 https://huggingface.co/barianoo/sinai-voice-ar-stt. 由于所有数据都是新收集的,结果衡量域外的概况。 采用标准推论设置评价模型: 在阿拉伯语的转录模式中低声,wav2vec2系统带有贪婪的CTC解码,其他系统则有默认生成程序.

blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate against manually reviewed references after identical Arabic normalization, including removal of diacritics and tatweel, unification of Alef/Hamza variants, normalization of Ta Marbuta and Alef Maqsura, and collapsing punctuation and whitespace variation. We report WER and CER for word- and character-level recognition. CER is particularly informative for Arabic due to morphological complexity and cliticisation. MER, which normalizes word errors by total word events, is additionally reported to capture cases where WER is affected by hypothesis length.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们对照同样的阿拉伯正常化后人工审查的参考文献进行评价,包括去除二极论和tatweel、统一Alef/Hamza变体、Ta Marbuta和Alef Maqsura的正常化以及崩盘和白空间变异。 我们报告WER和CER的词和字符级识别. CER由于形态复杂和文化,阿拉伯语的信息特别丰富. MER通过总字数事件使字数错误正常化,另外还报告了WER受假说长度影响的情况.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Top tier and WER/CER dissociation. Table 2 reports WER and CER for all 12 systems across six dialect families. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall error ( 34.9 % 34.9\% WER, 16.5 % 16.5\% CER), followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B ( 41.1 % / 20.6 % 41.1\%/20.6\% ), Fanar-STT-LF ( 45.9 % / 21.0 % 45.9\%/21.0\% ), and Whisper-Large-v3 ( 49.5 % / 29.0 % 49.5\%/29.0\% ). Wav2Vec2-based systems and Sinai-STT remain substantially behind ( 79 79 – 86 % 86\% WER). Their large WER/CER gaps indicate partial character-level agreement despite incorrect word recognition, with errors mainly involving deletions and substitutions of weak letters and short function morphemes. Dialect-to-MSA substitutions occur but are not the dominant failure pattern, highlighting the importance of reporting both WER and CER.
blocks.zh: 最高层和WER/CER分离. 表2报告六个方言家庭所有12个系统的WER和CER。 GPT-4o 语录实现 最低的总误差(34.9% 34.9% 的WER,16.5% 16.5% 的CER),其次是Voxtral-Mini-4B(41.1% / 20.6% 41.1/20.6 的\%)、Fanar-STT-LF(45.9% / 21.0% 45.9% / 2.1.0 +)和Whisper-Large-v3(49.5% / 29.0% 49.5 / 29.0 + 2/29.0 + ). Wav2Vec2-基于Sinai-STT的系统仍然大大落后(79 79 – 86 % 86 + WER)。 它们的WER/CER大缺口表明,尽管字识别不正确,但部分字符级别一致,错误主要涉及弱字母的删除和替换以及短函数摩尔.  Dialect-to-MSA 替代发生,但并不是主要的失败模式,突出了报告WER和CER的重要性.

blocks.en: Family-level variation. ALMIEYAR evaluates model behaviour across dialect communities rather than ranking dialect difficulty. Error rates vary across families and systems due to differences in model coverage, training exposure, and benchmark content. Substantial variation also exists within families: dialect-level gaps reach 16.8 16.8 points in Maghrebi and 12.8 12.8 points in Gulf, showing that family averages can hide dialect-specific behaviour.
blocks.zh: 家庭层面的变化。 ALMIEYAR评价跨方言社区的模型行为,而不是排名方言难度. 由于模型覆盖面、培训风险和基准内容不同,各家庭和系统的错误率各不相同。 家庭内部也存在很大差异:方言层面的差距在马格里布语为16.816.8分,海湾语为12.812.8分,表明家庭平均值可以隐藏方言特有的行为.

blocks.en: Gulf (4.0 h). Gulf achieves relatively strong results, with Voxtral and GPT-4o-transcribe reaching 35.7 % 35.7\% and 36.4 % 36.4\% WER, respectively. Performance varies across Bahraini, Omani, Qatari, Saudi, and Yemeni Arabic, motivating evaluation beyond family-level aggregation.
blocks.zh: 海湾(4.0 h). 海湾取得了相对较强的结果,Voxtral和GPT-4o-transit分别达到35.7%和36.4%的WER. 巴林、阿曼、卡塔尔、沙特和也门阿拉伯语的成绩不尽相同,促使评价超越家庭层面。

blocks.en: Levantine (3.0 h). GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest Levantine WER ( 33.6 % 33.6\% ), followed by Fanar-STT-LF ( 45.3 % 45.3\% ) and Voxtral ( 47.1 % 47.1\% ). SeamlessM4T-v2 shows a large WER/CER discrepancy ( 69.7 % 69.7\% WER, 52.0 % 52.0\% CER), indicating substantial character-level confusion.
blocks.zh: 莱万丁(3.0 h). GPT-4o-trancis实现最低的Levantine WER(33.6% 33.6\%),其次是Fanar-STT-LF(45.3% 45.3\%)和Voxtral(47.1% 47.1\%). SeamlessM4T-v2显示WER/CER差异较大(69.7% 69.7\% WER,52.0% 52.0\% CER),表明存在实质性的字符级混淆.

blocks.en: Maghrebi (3.8 h). Maghrebi remains challenging for several systems, with notable variation among dialects. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves 34.9 % 34.9\% average WER, while weaker systems show substantially higher error rates. Wav2Vec2 models again exhibit large WER/CER gaps, reflecting partial character overlap despite word-level errors.
blocks.zh: 马格里布人(3.8 h). 对几个系统来说,马格里布仍然具有挑战性,各方言之间有显著差异。 GPT-4o-trancis实现34.9%的平均WER,而较弱的系统显示的误差率要高得多. Wav2Vec2模型再次显示出WER/CER的较大缺口,尽管存在文字级别错误,但反映了部分字符重叠.

blocks.en: Iraqi and Ahwazi (1.6 h). This low-resource setting shows strong performance for leading models: GPT-4o-transcribe achieves 28.3 % 28.3\% WER, followed by Voxtral ( 44.4 % 44.4\% ) and Fanar-STT-LF ( 46.6 % 46.6\% ). The combined family contains variation between Iraqi and Ahwazi Arabic, with Ahwazi providing a previously uncovered evaluation setting.
blocks.zh: 伊拉克语和阿瓦齐语(1.6 h). 这种低资源设置显示主要模型的性能很强:GPT-4o-transit实现28.3%的WER,其次是Voxtral(44.4%)和Fanar-STT-LF(46.6%的46.6)。 综合家族包含伊拉克人和Ahwazi阿拉伯语之间的差异,而Ahwazi提供了之前未发现的评价环境。

blocks.en: Egyptian (0.7 h). Egyptian Arabic shows high error rates for several systems. GPT-4o-transcribe , Voxtral , and Moonshine-AR achieve 49.7 % 49.7\% , 59.9 % 59.9\% , and 81.8 % 81.8\% WER, respectively, while SeamlessM4T-v2 achieves 43.9 % 43.9\% .
blocks.zh: 埃及语( 0. 7 h). 埃及阿拉伯语显示一些系统错误率很高. GPT-4o-trancis , Voxtral , 和 Moonshine-AR 分别实现了49.7% 49.7%,59.9% 59.9%,81.8% 81.8% WER, 而 Seamless M4T-v2 则实现了43.9% 43.9%.

blocks.en: Sudanese (0.7 h). GPT-4o-transcribe achieves 30.6 % 30.6\% WER, followed by Voxtral at 35.8 % 35.8\% WER and 15.0 % 15.0\% CER. Lower-performing systems exceed 74 % 74\% WER, showing continued challenges for under-represented dialects.
blocks.zh: 苏丹语( 0.7 h). GPT-4o-trancis实现30.6% 30.6% WER,其次是Voxtral,为35.8% 35.8% WER,为15.0% 15.0% CER. 表现较差的系统超过了74%的74QQWER,表明代表不足的方言仍然面临挑战.

blocks.en: Model comparison across dialects. GPT-4o-transcribe provides the strongest overall result, while other systems show relative strengths across specific dialect groups. These differences demonstrate that aggregate scores alone do not fully capture dialectal ASR behaviour and motivate evaluation across diverse communities.
blocks.zh: 跨方言模式比较. GPT-4o-trancis提供了最强的整体结果,而其他系统则显示出特定方言组的相对优势. 这些差异表明,单靠总分并不能充分反映方言性ASR行为并激励不同社区进行评价。

blocks.en: 6 Match Error Rate Results
blocks.zh: 6 匹配错误率结果

blocks.en: Table 3 reports MER across evaluated models and six dialect families. MER normalises word-level errors by total word events, making it more conservative than WER when hypotheses contain more words than the references. Results are broadly consistent with Table 2 . The Wav2Vec2 family and Sinai-STT remain among the highest-error systems, with their large WER/CER differences indicating substantial character-level overlap despite incorrect word-level predictions.
blocks.zh: 表3 报告 市面汇率跨越评价模型和六个方言家庭。 MER通过总的单词事件使单词级别错误正常化,当假设包含的单词多于引用时,它比WER更加保守. 结果与表2大体一致。 Wav2Vec2家族和Sinai-STT仍然属于最错误的系统,尽管对字级的预测不正确,但是它们的巨大WER/CER差异表明,字符级重叠很大。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Almieyar , a culturally grounded and contamination free Arabic ASR benchmark covering 17 dialects across six families, including the first published Ahwazi benchmark. The benchmark is constructed through community-guided image descriptions using entirely newly recorded speech. Across 12 zero-shot systems, including both open-weight and closed-weight models, current ASR systems still exhibit substantial errors on diverse Arabic dialect communities, with GPT-4o-transcribe achieving the strongest overall performance at 34.9 % 34.9\% WER. The variation across systems and dialect groups highlights the importance of evaluating ASR models across diverse communities rather than relying on a single aggregate score. The WER/CER analysis further shows that different architectures exhibit different failure patterns, demonstrating the need for multi-metric evaluation of Arabic dialect ASR.
blocks.zh: 包括第一个公布的Ahwazi基准。 基准是通过社区指导的图像描述构建的,使用的是全新录制的语音. 整个12个零镜头系统,包括开放重量和封闭重量模型,目前的ASR系统在不同的阿拉伯语方言社区中仍然显示出重大错误,GPT-4o-transcritics在34.9%的WER中取得了最强的整体性能. 不同系统和方言群体之间的差异突出表明,必须评价不同社区的ASR模型,而不是依赖单一的总分。 WER/CER分析进一步显示,不同的架构表现出不同的故障模式,表明需要对阿拉伯语方言ASR进行多度评价.

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: Almieyar represents a meaningful step toward equitable dialectal Arabic ASR evaluation, but several limitations remain. (i) Single elicitation modality. The benchmark is built entirely from image-description speech. While effective at surfacing culturally grounded vocabulary, it does not capture other registers such as conversational dialogue, read speech, broadcast monologue, or domain-specific discourse (medical, legal, technical). (ii) Scale per dialect. With ≈ \approx 50 minutes per dialect, performance estimates carry non-trivial variance for the lower-resource families (e.g., Ahwazi, Sudanese, Iraqi); statistical comparisons between similarly performing models on a single dialect should be interpreted as indicative rather than definitive. (iii) Discrete dialect categories. Arabic dialects form a continuum rather than a partition; our 17-way labelling is a working approximation. Speaker-level metadata (age, gender, urban/rural background, education) is recorded but not used as a stratification variable in headline results. (iv) Zero-shot only. We evaluate models out-of-the-box; performance after dialect-specific fine-tuning is left to future work. (v) Reference quality. Coordinator review reduces but does not eliminate transcription ambiguity, especially around code-switching boundaries and dialect-internal orthographic conventions where no single normative spelling exists.
blocks.zh: Almiayar是朝着公平的阿拉伯语ASR方言评价迈出的有意义的一步,但仍有一些限制。 (i) 单一诱导方式。 基准完全由图像描述语句构建. 它虽然能有效浏览基于文化的词汇,但不能捕捉其他登记册,如对话、阅读言论、广播独白或特定领域(医疗、法律、技术)的言论。 (二)每方言规模. 由于每个方言大约为50分钟,对资源较少的家庭(如Ahwazi、苏丹、伊拉克)来说,绩效估计具有非部落差异;对单一方言上类似性能模型的统计比较应解释为指示性的,而不是确定的。 (三)分明的方言类. 阿拉伯语方言形成一个连续体而不是分区;我们的17条路标是一个可行的近似点。 发言人一级的元数据(年龄、性别、城市/农村背景、教育)被记录下来,但在标题结果中没有用作分层变量。 (四)只有零射门. 我们评价模式外出;在方言特定微调后的表现留待未来工作. (五) 参考质量。 协调员的审查减少但并未消除抄写上的模糊性,特别是在没有单一规范拼写的情况下,围绕代码转换界限和方言-内部正字法公约。

blocks.en: 9 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 9 道德考虑

blocks.en: Contributor roles and authorship. We distinguish two roles in Almieyar ’s construction, with the ethical implications of each handled differently: • Dialect-community coordinators carried out substantive intellectual work: curating culturally representative image sets for their dialect, recruiting and supervising speakers, calibrating elicitation prompts, performing final transcription review, and adjudicating dialect-internal orthographic conventions. Following the standard CRediT / ICMJE criteria for authorship (substantial contribution, drafting/review, and final approval), each coordinator is listed as a co-author of this paper. • Native-speaker participants contributed bounded one-time recordings ( ≈ \approx 50 minutes per speaker). Their contribution falls below the threshold for authorship under CRediT, so it is recognised through a fair monetary compensation paid for their time, plus a named acknowledgement (with explicit consent) in the released datasheet. We followed local minimum-wage benchmarks and approved IRB compensation rates in each contributor country.
blocks.zh: 贡献者角色与作者. 我们在Almiayar的建筑中区分了两个角色,每个角色的道德影响不同: 对话-社区协调员开展了实质性的知识工作:为其方言绘制具有文化代表性的图象,招聘和监督演讲者,校准诱导提示,进行最后的抄写审查,以及裁定方言-内部正字形的公约。 按照CRediT / ICMJE关于作者资格的标准(实质性贡献,起草/审查,以及最后批准),每位协调员被列为本文的共同作者. • 讲土著语的与会者提供有限度的一次性录音(每个发言者约50分钟)。 其贡献低于CrediT下作者资格的门槛,因此通过为他们的时间支付公平的金钱补偿,加上公布的数据表中的命名确认(经明确同意)。 我们遵循当地最低工资基准,并核准了每个捐助国的移民和难民局补偿标准。

blocks.en: Dialect-community coordinators carried out substantive intellectual work: curating culturally representative image sets for their dialect, recruiting and supervising speakers, calibrating elicitation prompts, performing final transcription review, and adjudicating dialect-internal orthographic conventions. Following the standard CRediT / ICMJE criteria for authorship (substantial contribution, drafting/review, and final approval), each coordinator is listed as a co-author of this paper.
blocks.zh: 对话社区协调员开展了实质性的智力工作:为其方言绘制具有文化代表性的图象;征聘和监督讲方言者;校准诱导提示;进行最后的抄录审查;以及裁定方言内部的正字法惯例。 按照CRediT / ICMJE关于作者资格的标准(实质性贡献,起草/审查,以及最后批准),每位协调员被列为本文的共同作者.

blocks.en: Native-speaker participants contributed bounded one-time recordings ( ≈ \approx 50 minutes per speaker). Their contribution falls below the threshold for authorship under CRediT, so it is recognised through a fair monetary compensation paid for their time, plus a named acknowledgement (with explicit consent) in the released datasheet. We followed local minimum-wage benchmarks and approved IRB compensation rates in each contributor country.
blocks.zh: 讲土著语的与会者贡献了限定的一次性录音(每个发言者大约50分钟)。 其贡献低于CrediT下作者资格的门槛,因此通过为他们的时间支付公平的金钱补偿,加上公布的数据表中的命名确认(经明确同意)。 我们遵循当地最低工资基准,并核准了每个捐助国的移民和难民局补偿标准。

blocks.en: Informed consent. All speakers gave written informed consent for use of their voice recordings and transcriptions in research and in the public release of Almieyar . Consent forms were provided in the speaker’s dialect (oral readback where literacy was uneven) and explicitly enumerated the licence, the planned redistribution, and the right to withdraw before publication.
blocks.zh: 知情同意。 所有发言者都书面表示同意在研究和公开发布Almiayar时使用录音和录音。 发言者的方言中提供了同意表(在识字程度不均的情况下,口头复读),并明确列举了许可证、计划的再分配以及出版前退出的权利。

blocks.en: Personally identifying information (PII). We retain only the dialect label and a study-internal speaker ID with the released audio; speaker names, contact details, demographic metadata at individual granularity, and any incidental PII surfaced during recording (e.g., mentions of family members) were redacted or pseudonymised by the coordinators before release.
blocks.zh: 个人识别信息(PII). 我们只保留了方言标签和带有已发布的音频的学习-内部扬声器标识;扬声器名称、联系方式、单个颗粒度的人口元数据,以及录制过程中出现的任何附带的PII(例如提及家庭成员)在发布前都由协调员编辑或假名。

blocks.en: Cultural representation. Image selection and transcript review reflect community judgement about cultural authenticity rather than top-down decisions made by the core authors. Where dialects span national boundaries (e.g., Iraqi/Ahwazi, Levantine across four states), multiple coordinators were consulted; disagreements were resolved by majority vote of coordinators native to the disputed sub-region.
blocks.zh: 文化代表性. 图片选择和笔录审查反映了社区对文化真实性的判断,而不是核心作者自上而下的决定. 如果方言跨越国界(例如伊拉克语/阿瓦齐语、黎凡丁语跨越四个州),就征求了多个协调员的意见;分歧通过争议的次区域的协调员的多数票解决。

blocks.en: Intended use and misuse. Almieyar is intended for the evaluation of Arabic ASR systems; it is not a training corpus, and we explicitly discourage its repackaging as one to avoid contaminating future benchmarks. Released ASR outputs reflect model behaviour as of evaluation time and should not be used to make individual-level claims about speakers.
blocks.zh: 有意使用和滥用。 Almiayar旨在评价阿拉伯的ASR系统;它不是一个培训机构,我们明确劝阻它作为一个机构重新包装,以避免污染未来的基准。 公布的ASR产出反映了评价时间的示范行为,不应用于对发言者提出个人要求。

blocks.en: Release and datasheet. The dataset, all evaluation scripts, model-output transcripts, and per-utterance metric reports will be released under a permissive licence, alongside a datasheet documenting collection methodology, processing pipeline, coordinator and speaker compensation rates, and known biases (e.g., within-dialect speaker-demographic skews).
blocks.zh: 发布与数据表. 数据集、所有评价脚本、模型输出记录稿和节食量度报告将在允许许可的情况下发布,同时发布一个数据表,记录收集方法、处理管道、协调员和演讲者报酬率以及已知的偏差(例如,内向演讲者-人口skews)。

blocks.en: Appendix A Five-Scenario Elicitation Instructions
blocks.zh: 附录A 五个实例说明

blocks.en: Instructions were provided to coordinators in both English and their dialect’s written Arabic.
blocks.zh: 向协调员提供了英语及其方言的阿拉伯文教学。

blocks.en: Scenario 1, Cultural Context. Describe the cultural image in detail using your dialect. Focus on: (a) the big picture and what the image represents; (b) where the scene is set; (c) the specific tradition, festival, or activity depicted; (d) historical or cultural significance; (e) any clues about time of day or season.
blocks.zh: 情景1,文化背景。 用你的方言详细描述文化形象。 重点是:(a)大局和画面代表什么;(b)场景设定地点;(c)所描绘的具体传统、节日或活动;(d)历史或文化意义;(e)关于日或季节的任何线索。

blocks.en: Scenario 2, Central Subjects. Describe the primary figures or objects in the image. Cover: (a) who or what dominates the image; (b) their placement and orientation; (c) specific colours, textures, or notable details; (d) how multiple subjects relate to each other.
blocks.zh: 设想2,中心主题。 描述图像中的主要数字或对象。 涵盖:(a) 由谁或什么主导图像;(b) 其位置和方向;(c) 具体颜色、纹理或显著细节;(d) 多个主题如何相互关联。

blocks.en: Scenario 3, Background and Environment. Describe the setting and surroundings. Address: (a) what is visible in the background; (b) architecture, natural elements, or decorative features; (c) how the background complements or contrasts the central subjects; (d) patterns, textures, or recurring elements.
blocks.zh: 设想3,背景和环境。 描述背景和周围环境。 地址:(a) 背景可见的内容;(b) 结构、自然要素或装饰特征;(c) 背景如何补充或对比中心主体;(d) 模式、纹理或经常性要素。

blocks.en: Scenario 4, Colours, Textures, and Mood. Describe the sensory and emotional qualities. Include: (a) dominant colours and their locations; (b) textures of objects or surfaces; (c) cultural symbolism of specific colours; (d) how lighting and shadows create emotional tone.
blocks.zh: 情景4,颜色,纹理,和Mood. 描述感官和情感品质. 包括:(a) 主流颜色及其位置;(b) 物体或表面的纹理;(c) 特定颜色的文化象征;(d) 照明和阴影如何产生情感语气。

blocks.en: Scenario 5, Interpretive Meaning. Describe the deeper significance of the image. Address: (a) the cultural narrative or message; (b) the emotional impact on you as a viewer; (c) connection to cultural, historical, or spiritual roots; (d) why this scene is meaningful in a modern context.
blocks.zh: 情景5,解释意义. 描述图像的更深层意义. 地址:(a) 文化叙事或信息;(b) 对你作为观众的情感影响;(c) 与文化、历史或精神根源的联系;(d) 为何这一场景在现代背景下有意义。

blocks.en: Appendix B Telegram Bot Collection Interface
blocks.zh: 附录B Telegram 瓶装收藏接口

blocks.en: The Telegram bot (Figure 1 ) guided each participant through: (1) display image with scenario instructions in the speaker’s dialect; (2) record voice message (30–60 s); (3) auto-transcribe via Google Cloud ASR; (4) display transcription in editable field for in-line correction; (5) submit and repeat for remaining scenarios. Recordings were stored with metadata: speaker ID, dialect, image ID, scenario number, timestamp, and duration. Coordinator review used a separate web interface with line-by-line comparison of original and corrected transcriptions.
blocks.zh: Telegram bot(图1)指导每位参与者通过:(1) 在演讲方言中显示带有情景指令的图像;(2) 记录语音信息(30-60秒);(3) 通过Google Cloud ASR自动调试;(4) 在可编辑的栏目中显示可进行线内校正的抄写;(5) 提交和重复其余情景。 记录用元数据存储:扬声器ID,方言,图像ID,情景号,时间戳,以及持续时间. 协调员审查使用单独的网络界面,对原文和经更正的抄录进行逐行比较。
